## HL · Posting week: draft (Lesson 5.4)
Fridays 14:00: read next week's Calendar rows, the brand voice, the price list and last week's results. For each idea the AI writes one version per platform (structured output). A Code node checks each version against the platform rules and banned phrases. Failures go back to the AI once, then to Tolu marked needs_edit.

Sheets (YOUR_SHEET_ID):
- Calendar: date, time, pillar, idea, product, platforms (comma list), media_file (public URL), status
- Posts: post_key, calendar_id, platform, pillar, product, caption, alt_text, media_file, scheduled_at, uses_price, price_used, problems, status, approved_by, post_id, published_at, reach, engagement, clicks
- Brand voice: rules (one cell; add a line Banned: phrase; phrase)
- Price list: product, price, stock

Credentials: Google Sheets; OpenAI.
Placeholders: YOUR_SHEET_ID, YOUR_MODEL.

nodes.name: One calendar item at a time

messageValues.message: You are Harvest Lane's social media writer. Write one version of the idea for each listed platform, in that platform's shape: Instagram visual and warm; Facebook friendly with one call to action; LinkedIn for restaurants and hotels; X very short; TikTok a hook for a short video; WhatsApp only a short weekly-offer line. Follow the brand voice. Use a price only if one is given, written with the naira sign exactly as given, and set uses_price true. Never invent prices, discounts, stock, health claims or customers. Few hashtags. Always write alt text describing the real photo or video.
Rewrite every version so that it passes all the checks listed. Keep the same rules: one version per listed platform, prices only as given, no invented claims, alt text always.

Platform checks (second try) runs the same code. Anything still failing is saved as needs_edit with its problems, so Tolu sees why.

Mark calendar drafted: if your sheet has no row_number column to match on, add a calendar_id column instead and match on that.
